name: Master Full-Function Keyboard Pro
author: Cute master
description: Official 4.7 update, with up to 39 widget groups, built only to meet your gaming needs. The base interface uses fully transparent textured buttons, clean and rigorous, with sensible button placement; Jade is reserved at the top center and a minimap at the top right. Clear widget logic. New features: quick commands, auto keys, auto clicker, plus two full keyboards: a center-screen full keyboard, pull it out anytime without blocking normal gameplay; Full Keyboard Pro, this area uses up to 18 widget groups, containing: one set of collapsible function keys, two sets of collapsible number keys, three grip styles, switchable show/hide WASD, and a separate joystick/d-pad. Yes, this may currently be the only layout on the internet supporting 2-finger, 3-finger and 4-finger grip switching, perfectly fitting mods like TACZ and giving your modpack an immersive experience. It supports joystick and dpad, with an original center-symmetric design, collapsible function and number keys, freely combinable widgets, no overlap conflicts anywhere, a full keyboard that never interrupts movement - a unique sense of logic. It also includes a PVP layout, a unique competitive key set, clear and rigorous, so you dominate. Both keyboards have been merged into Utility Functions in 4.7. A MODS key bar has been specially added for mods so you can add your own mod keys; this widget group stands alone and works with both keyboards, with great freedom, so edit with confidence. JEI keys and a minimap are built in. For questions, suggestions or making friends, add the author's QQ: 3054421046

Here is a letter from the author            Click the letter area to exit
Dear Player:
Hello
Thank you for choosing my button layout. The Master Full Keyboard Pro aims to build an excellent widget group that fits every player's needs and habits. This version contains 39 widget groups; this area uses up to 18 of them, including: one set of collapsible function keys, two sets of collapsible number keys, three grip styles, switchable show/hide WASD, and switchable separate joystick and dpad. Yes, this may currently be the only layout on the internet supporting 2-finger, 3-finger and 4-finger grip switching, perfectly fitting mods like TACZ. It supports joystick and dpad, a center-symmetric design, collapsible function and number keys, freely combinable widgets, no overlap conflicts anywhere, and a full keyboard that never interrupts movement
Next you need to know the following:
1. The center top ↺ button is the master control button, used to collapse widgets and exit the full keyboard. In short, if an ⌨ icon appears below ↺ there are uncollapsed widgets; you must collapse them all before exiting. This design prevents overlap
2. Widget collapse order: number keys, function keys, WASD
(Be sure not to change the widget group order)
3. Widget group: MODS (independently editable, movable without bugs). In Full Keyboard Pro and the PVP keyboard, if it is not collapsed it will overlap - this is intentional; please collapse it with the control switch before entering. The control switch is MODS+ (top left of the main screen). To use it in the full keyboard, move MODS yourself to avoid overlap; this widget group stands alone, is very flexible, edit with confidence
4. For feedback contact QQ: 3054421046
                                          —— Cute Master                To avoid accidental taps, please delete the widget group: Publication Statement
